audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text calls Ekko's mobility 'Rift Walker' — that is not an Ekko ability; his dash is Phase Dive (E). content.early claims 'his E has a long cooldown early' — Phase Dive is 9s at rank 1. breakdown.cooldowns carried no number, and two bullets were the trade lines pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Riot text: Phase Dive rolls, then the next attack teleports him to the target — 9/8.5/8/7.5/7 with an auto-attack reset. Parallel Convergence is 22/20/18/16/14 and stuns only if Ekko enters his own anomaly. Chronobreak is 110/80/50, untargetable, and heals a share of damage taken in the rewind window.
audit.corrected: Dash named correctly, its real 9s cooldown stated, Chronobreak's 110/80/50 and the anti-heal requirement written in.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions lists two absent items: Chronobreak's heal (anti-heal timing) and the Phase Dive auto-reset tell.
audit.why: Chronobreak heals a percentage of damage received during the rewind, so ungapped burst is refunded; Phase Dive's teleport happens on the attack, not the roll, so the roll is the cue.
audit.corrected: breakdown.late now names Grievous Wounds and dosFull[1].d keys the punish to the wind-up rather than the cast.

edits.before: - Ekko Chronobreak: matchup-defining — Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Pale Cascade like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Chronobreak is 110s at rank 1 but only 50s at rank 3 — track the hologram and hold your final damage until after the rewind. - Parallel Convergence is 22s early. - Phase Dive is 9s, so his escape is nearly always up. - Pale Cascade is 15s: never trade without orbs.

edits.before: Q through the wave onto his chest, E the mark, three-hit string, walk — the phase trade he answers after you've left.
edits.after: Phase Dive is only 9s at rank 1 — punish the wind-up, not the cast; the auto that finally lands is the teleport.

edits.before: Dashing onto an unmarked target with W down — Diana without the reset or the shield is a melee mage donating proximity.
edits.after: Chronobreak rewinds him to where he stood seconds ago and heals it back — chasing spends your dash into his safety net.

edits.before: Carry through the dive — mark, dash, pull, delete; your R turns their teamfight spacing into a suggestion.
edits.after: Carry by holding damage through Chronobreak — mark, dash, pull, and kill him after the rewind lands.

edits.before: You are the dive: E through the front line onto their carry, R the collapse, and let the resets carry you out famous.
edits.after: You are the dive, but buy Grievous Wounds first — Chronobreak heals back a share of everything you just did to him.

edits.before: Lost Chapter keeps your all-in tempo constant, and Ekko's Rift Walker mobility doesn't matter if you land Q first — he still has to fully commit W stun to beat you.
edits.after: Lost Chapter keeps your all-in tempo constant, and Phase Dive (E) doesn't matter if you land Q first — he still has to fully commit the Parallel Convergence stun to beat you.

edits.before: You win this lane by simply being faster to commit — Ekko's damage output before level 6 relies on Z-Drive Resonance stacking on autos, which takes several hits to matter, while your burst combo threatens kill from level 3 on. Punish him whenever he throws Timewinder for poke without immediate follow-up, since his E has a long cooldown early. Watch his W field placement; walking through it for a stun is the only way he beats your all-in.
edits.after: You win this lane by simply being faster to commit — Ekko's damage output before level 6 relies on Z-Drive Resonance stacking on autos, which takes several hits to matter, while your burst combo threatens kill from level 3 on. Punish him whenever he throws Timewinder for poke without immediate follow-up. Phase Dive is 9s at rank 1, so watch the roll, and watch his W field placement; walking through it for a stun is the only way he beats your all-in.
